sent.subject: Sorry about the fourteen emails — cause found and fixed
sent.body:
Hi Faraz,

You're right, and I'm sorry. Fourteen emails for one change is genuinely
annoying and there's no version of that which is acceptable.

The cause was on our side and it is now understood. The system that
watches our inbox and sends you those acknowledgements is supposed to
run as a single process. A scheduling fault meant it quietly started a
new copy of itself every hour without shutting down the previous one,
until seventeen copies were running at once. Each one saw your message
arrive and each one replied, all within the same second — so you got
fourteen near-identical emails instead of one.

Two things have been done. The scheduler has been stopped so no further
copies can start, and the program itself now refuses to run if another
copy is already active — so even if the scheduling fault recurs, it
cannot produce this again. The duplicate copies still running are being
cleared today.

Your actual request — the reworded message for visitors with fewer th
